description: Implementation of Stage I of the Oliyamulla Pumping Station Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The canal system associated with the Mudun Ela catchment area connects to the Kelani River at the areas of Oliyamulla, Peliyagoda and Pethiyagoda. During flood periods in the upper reaches of the Kelani River, floodwaters enter the said urban areas through those canals, placing the low-lying areas within the Mudun Ela catchment at risk of flooding. Studies conducted on the said issue have recommended the construction of a water pumping station in the Oliyamulla area where the main canal of the relevant catchment connects to the Kelani River, to mitigate flood risks. Accordingly, it has been planned to implement a project for the construction of water pumping stations with a total capacity of 35m³/s, under the financial assistance of the Government of Sri Lanka and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA). It is expected to construct a pumping station with a capacity of 15m³/s under stage I and another with a capacity of 20m³/s under stage II, of the relevant project. As such, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to implement Stage I of the Oliyamulla Pumping Station Project during the period of 2027-2031, under a total estimated cost of Rs.5,962.13 million, was approved by the Cabinet.
